purpose: Assess the proposed 300-family-per-class confirmation inventory without choosing a panel, reading candidate answers or generating new source/candidate scores.
decision: The recorded nominal v3-family exclusions leave 303 families per class, three more than proposed. This is inventory arithmetic, not approval or proof of 300 suitable, candidate-unexposed, statistically independent families. Do not drop exclusions or reduce the registered count to make a future campaign pass.

baseline_reconstruction.kind: Deterministic replay of sampling metadata; reconstructed identities are not historical execution logs.
baseline_reconstruction.algorithm: One random.Random(17) for the complete ordered class list; stream each file preserving row order into family-to-row-ID lists; sort family IDs, rng.shuffle them, then rng.choice one row ID from each of the first20 families before advancing to the next class. No candidate/source inference.

limitations: Both preserved artifact versions record N=20 and seed17; neither records sampled row IDs or source file hashes at execution time.

Reconstruction assumes the recorded class order, corpus family IDs and within-family row order were those used by the historical runs. Current hashes are recorded; nine baseline input files match calibration provenance, while arithmetic_chain has no calibration provenance entry.

Sampling code changed only logging/scoring across inspected historical revisions; metadata-only reconstruction does not compare stored answer strings and cannot independently authenticate the run-time sample.
Unrecorded scans, altered CLI counts, overwritten intermediate artifacts and local exploratory executions cannot be excluded from the repository evidence alone.

unreconstructed_or_uncertain_exclusions: No complete execution/exposure ledger covers every historical exploratory invocation, interrupted process or external checkout.
Historical baseline scans omit row IDs and input hashes; their sampled IDs above remain conditional deterministic reconstructions.

The old task_arithmetic.jsonl name was changed to task_probe.jsonl in dc014ca; inspected build_splits.py sampling logic did not change, but no original old-name runtime file remains here to authenticate all historical uses.
Original split builders loaded the entire corpus; this audit does not claim that corpus prompts were globally unread or never inspected.
Synthetic pilot group IDs are disjoint nominally; this metadata-only audit does not establish semantic separation from corpus reasoning templates.
Cross-family semantic similarity, shared underlying generators, possible duplicate semantic source instances and external training/evaluation exposure require review.

statistical_independence.verdict: Distinct numeric v3 family IDs do not establish independent semantic sampling units or justify binomial population inference. Until an adequately justified family-sampling model is reviewed, issue finite-panel measurements only.
observations: Each class has 125 counterfactual v3 families of4 rows and250 regular v3 families of8 rows.
Each of the8 source_base_template_family values occurs across all250 regular v3 families in its class.
Identical source_index values cross nominal v3 family IDs:12 percentage_reasoning,8 ratio_proportion and5 time_duration values.
The v3 generator uses shared base generators and finite framing/dialogue patterns; its new family labels encode construction groups, not proven independent semantic task families.
